messages:
maria: FYI -- noticed elevated 5xx rate across /v1/embeddings in us-west after the 03:12 deploy. alerts: 503 backend_read_error, latency > 6s for many requests. impact looks like: some customers getting timeouts, others partial responses. tagging @sam oncall. :rotating_light:
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED · ID INC-2026-042 · severity: P2 · triggered by rate of 503s on embeddings-prod-usw2. Page sent to oncall. Auto-attach: recent deploy 2026-03-15-03:12.
sam: I'm taking this. quick check: is this isolated to embeddings route or also text generation?
maria: primarly embeddings route `/v1/embeddings` and reranker traffic. text gen paths look normal.
sam: copying steps I'm running so agents can follow: 1) confirm status page (internal), 2) triage logs for backend pool OOMs, 3) if model pool is saturated, scale dedicate or failover to fallback model. will update.
nash (ops-bot): autoscaler triggered 2x scale-up attempts at 03:14 and 03:16, both failed due to missing GPU quota in us-west-2-account-prod.
nash (ops-bot): recent kernel log snippet: `E tensorflow_serving::Predict impl: failed to allocate buffer: out_of_memory` repeated 47 times in 03:13-03:18 window.
nash (ops-bot): fallback routing to smaller-quantized model (embed-small-q4) is configured but hasn't been activated automatically due to policy `preserve_quality=true` on this customer cohort.
nash (ops-bot): recommended initial mitigation: 1) flip fallback policy to allow auto-failover to embed-small-q4, 2) post status page update, 3) notify CS to use short-form customer ack macro.
nash (ops-bot): tagging @kevin for quota request to cloud provider.
kevin: I'm on quota request now. asked cloud support for emergency GPU quota +50, ETA ~20-40m. In parallel, I'm approving fallback policy flip with infra.
nash (ops-bot): NOTE: changing fallback policy will increase token-level variance for affected customers. communicate clearly.
nash (ops-bot): suggested statuspage message (internal draft):
```
We're investigating elevated error rates for embeddings in us-west-2. Some requests are returning 503 or timing out. Engineers are investigating and have triggered fallback routing to a smaller model while we resolve GPU capacity. We will post updates every 15 minutes. If you see this impacting production, please DM @sam or escalate via pager.
```
nash (ops-bot): suggested external customer-facing macro for Zendesk / Intercom: short/acknowledge + mitigation in-flight (use for volume ticket replies)
```
Hi {customer_name},
Thanks for flagging — we’re investigating higher-than-normal errors for embeddings in our us-west region and have engineers actively working on a mitigation. We’ve routed traffic to a temporary lower-capacity model to reduce errors while we restore full capacity. You may see increased latency or small differences in embedding outputs during this time.
We’ll update you again within 15 minutes or sooner if we have new info. Apologies for the disruption — please reply here if this is blocking production.
— The Redwood Support team
```
nash (ops-bot): expanded CS macro for high-touch customers (include SLO/compensation language):
```
Hi {customer_name},
We wanted to let you know we are actively investigating an issue affecting embeddings in us-west. Engineers have moved traffic to a fallback model to reduce errors while we address capacity. We know this may affect production and can offer priority routing or credits if you report production impact. If you'd like immediate assistance, please share a representative request and we can test behavior for you.
ETA for next update: 15 minutes.
— {agent_name}, Redwood Support
```
maria: tagging templates above into the CS macro library now. please make tiny edits for tone as needed.
nash (ops-bot): internal comms for engineering/exec slack (short update):
```
INC-2026-042: embeddings 503s in us-west after deploy. mitigation in progress: fallback routing to embed-small-q4 enabled (reduced capacity/quality). cloud quota request submitted. Next update in 15m. Owner: sam (oncall).
```
nash (ops-bot): triage checklist for first-responder agents (paste into Zendesk internal note):
```
1) Confirm incident ID and check statuspage (internal).
2) Run quick reproducibility: sample failing request id /log tail (cmd: `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d @sample.json -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"`)
3) Check customer region mapping (is user routed to us-west?).
4) If affected, send short macro (ACK) and ask for representative example.
5) If customer reports blocking production, escalate to sam (oncall) and use high-touch macro.
6) Note customer-friendly language and avoid technical spec claims (we used fallback model).
```
nash (ops-bot): Sample Zendesk internal note template for agents to attach to tickets:
```
INC-2026-042 | Acknowledged. Incident affecting embeddings in us-west-2; mitigation: fallback routing to embed-small-q4 enabled. Next update in 15m. Owner: sam (oncall). Please DM support if you need priority assistance.
```
nash (ops-bot): Intercom quick reply snippet (for chat):
```
Thanks for reporting — we're investigating higher error rates in us-west and have a mitigation in place. We'll follow up in 15 minutes. If you can provide a sample request/response, that speeds diagnosis. — Redwood Support
```
nash (ops-bot): Ops checklist for oncall handoff and runbook (include in handoff messages if this crosses shift):
```
- Current owner: sam (oncall).
- What we changed: enabled fallback routing to embed-small-q4 at 03:20.
- Why: GPU quota failure prevented scale-up after deploy; kernels hitting OOM.
- Known customer impact: increased 503s and higher latency for embeddings routed to us-west.
- Immediate next steps: monitor error rate, confirm fallback route success (observe drop in 5xx), coordinate with kevin for quota.
- Criteria to resolve (tentative): error rate back to baseline <0.5% and no ongoing OOM logs for 15m.
- Handoff checklist: heap of logs, list of affected accounts, status page URL, tickets using short macro.
```
nash (ops-bot): Handoff note for whoever takes next shift: include link to diagnostics (internal only): https://internal.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-042 and paste sample logs.
nash (ops-bot): Reaction summary: :thumbsup: on macros, :hourglass_flowing_sand: pending quota.
nash (ops-bot): Posting update on public status page now (short): "We are investigating elevated errors for embeddings in us-west. We have activated temporary fallback routing to reduce customer errors. Next update in 15 minutes."
nash (ops-bot): Post-update at 03:30: error rate dropped from 7.4% -> 1.1% after fallback policy flip; anecdotal CS reports reduced customer hits.
nash (ops-bot): Recommend continuing with fallback until quota restored.
nash (ops-bot): final internal note to attach to tickets once resolved:
```
INC-2026-042 resolved at 04:05. Root cause: failed autoscale due to cloud GPU quota shortage; mitigation: fallback routing enabled and quota increased. We will run a postmortem to review deploy-time autoscaler assumptions and quota verification.
```
nash (ops-bot): Closing loop: if you pushed a ticket reply, update internal note to 'linked to INC-2026-042'.
nash (ops-bot): cc @ashley for follow-up on customer communications and any refund/credit flows.
nash (ops-bot): end-of-thread summary pinned by maria: "ACKED -> mitigation applied (fallback) -> public + customer comms -> monitor -> quota request -> postmortem planned."
kevin: Quota increase confirmed at 03:58; autoscaler tested and can now scale to +3 GPUs. Will join postmortem.
nash (ops-bot): last update timestamped 04:05.
